name: Rune Focus, Greater
body:
You learn to further increase the potency of symbol-based magic.

Prerequisite(s) Rune Focus.

Benefit(s) Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against spells that create runes, symbols, sigils, words or glyphs. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Rune Focus.
